snippet.title: Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979 - Crowdfunding Campaign (Formerly Max Madness)
snippet.description:
⚠️ NOTE FOR BACKERS: This video was recorded prior to our official rebranding. The game "Max Madness" shown on the website in this video has been officially renamed to "Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979". The campaign, goals, and core game remain exactly the same!

🔥 Support our Crowdfunding Campaign: https://www.rodrigobanzato.com/donate
🟢 Wishlist JUST MADNESS: EARTH APOCALYPSE 1979 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652470/Just_Madness_Earth_Apocalypse_1979/

Our Game Studio: https://www.rodrigobanzato.com
My collections on FAB: https://www.fab.com/sellers/Rodrigo%20Banzato

***

IMPORTANT UPDATE:
Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979 is the new official title for the game previously developed under the name "Max Madness". Same terrifying vision, new atmospheric scale.

ABOUT THIS VIDEO:
An invitation to join our development journey and support the creation of a truly atmospheric open-world survival horror game. Find out how you can back the project, get exclusive rewards, and help shape the wasteland.

ABOUT THE GAME:
Just Madness: Earth Apocalypse 1979 is an atmospheric survival horror game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore harsh environments, manage your scarce resources, and survive the horrors of the wasteland.

🔗 Follow our development journey:
* IndieDB/ModDB: https://www.indiedb.com/members/rodrigobanzato/games
